Our two headliners for today’s edition is the newly launched Segway E3 Go Electric Scooter with $100 savings at $550 , which sits just $50 above the current pricing of its sibling E3 Pro model . Next, Bluetti has begun its 4-day Member Sale event that has a selection of deals on power stations units, solar panels, and expansion batteries, including 2x points and redemption deals, not to mention our exclusive bonus savings code. This sale is giving folks the chance at the FridgePower 2,016Wh Station with 2x points down at an exclusive $854 , amongst others. We’ve also got deals for the 40-mile Hiboy Max Pro e-scooter, the 40V Worx Nitro Leafjet blower, a 82V Greenworks chainsaw, and more. Don’t forget about yesterday’s hangover deals at the bottom of the page, like the EcoFlow power station Halloween Sale , or the new Monarc e-bike battery options that start prices lower than ever from $1,399, and more.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Segway expands its third-gen lineup with the new Find My-equipped E3 Go e-scooter launching at $550 ($100 off)
Segway has expanded its E3 e-scooter family with the launch of its newest E3 Go Electric Scooter down at $549.99 shipped . This new model is the most accessible third-generation model yet that will carry a $650 MSRP once this deal ends, coming as a counterpart to the E3 Pro e-scooter (currently discounted to $600). The deal gives you $100 savings cut from the tag, with there being no telling just how long it will last.
You can get the rundown of what to expect from Segway’s E3 Go e-scooter here .
Advertisement - scroll for more content
Bluetti’s October Member Sale drops FridgePower 2,016Wh station to exclusive $854 + 2x points, more from $119
As we see on the 20th of every month, Bluetti has launched its 4-Day Member Sale lineup of deals , which benefit from our exclusive bonus savings, but also include Bluetti Bucks redemption deals (at the bottom of the page), too. One notable inclusion during this sale that we haven’t seen as much of in the last few months is Bluetti’s FridgePower 2,016Wh Portable Power Station down at $854.05 shipped (giving you 2x Bluetti bucks), after using our exclusive code 9TO5TOYS5OFF in your cart, beating out Amazon by $645 . It carries a $949 MSRP directly from the brand, but is seen climbing as high as $1,499 at other marketplaces like Amazon. It’s been keeping to that $949 rate directly in the last few months of sales, though there have been some periodic drops to $899 at Amazon, and the 2-day Prime event two weeks ago saw it cut down to $850. The deal here gives you a combined $95 markdown off the going rate, landing it amongst its lowest tracked prices – $5 above Amazon’s lowest and $47 above Bluetti’s lowest from when it launched in June.
***Note: the exclusive bonus savings code has not been added into any of the prices you see below, so be sure to use 9TO5TOYS5OFF in your cart or at checkout to guarantee you’re getting even better deals – though it doesn’t work for the standalone expansion battery and solar panel offers. You’ll also gain 2x Bluetti Bucks with power station purchases, with some of them also getting FREE gear, too.

Apex 300 (7,884.8Wh) with B500K battery: $3,299 (Reg. $3,699)
2x Apex 300s (16,588.8Wh) with 4x B300K batteries and Hub A1: $7,699 (Reg. $8,497)
You can browse the full lineup of Bluetti’s Member deals in our original coverage of this sale here .
Hiboy’s MAX Pro electric scooter is a 47-mile commuter that hits 22 MPH and it’s down at $657 ($73 off)
Amazon is currently offering the Hiboy MAX Pro Electric Scooter down at $656.95 shipped , which beats out the brand’s direct website by $73 . While you’ll find it with a $1,000 MSRP directly from Hiboy, it has only ever gone as high as $730 in 2026 at Amazon, while more often keeping down at this rate through the year. We’ve seen it dip a little lower during the two Prime Day events this year, as well as the annual low that appeared back in January. This is the third-lowest price of 2026, giving you a $73 markdown off the going rate and $343 off the MSRP. If you want similar long-range travel at a cheaper price, you can also find the S2 Max e-scooter down at $490 right now.
Worx’s 40V Nitro Leafjet cordless blower brings along 620 CFM output + 2x batteries back at $160 ($40 off)
Amazon is currently offering the Worx Nitro Leafjet 40V 620 CFM Cordless Electric Leaf Blower with 2x 4.0Ah batteries down at $159.99 shipped . Down from $200, for most of 2026 we’ve seen discounts keeping things above $170, though the first two months of the year and summer saw some drops lower. The Prime Day event two weeks ago saw it fall to this same rate, with it coming back around to give you $40 savings in time to clear out all the fall foliage dropping from trees. You can also find a cheaper option in the 20V Leafjet with a 5.0Ah battery down at $129.99 shipped from $150, or the tool-only option at $89.99 shipped for those with an already sizeable battery collection.
Make 225 cuts with Greenworks’ 82V commercial-grade 16-inch cordless chainsaw down at $247 ($153 off)
Amazon is currently offering a more professional cutting experience with the Greenworks 82V 16-inch Cordless Electric Chainsaw with a 4.0Ah battery down at $247.11 shipped , beating out the brand’s direct website pricing by $53 . This model hit the market back in early 2025, with it dropping down from a $400 full price here. Discounts this year have seen it go as low as $212 back during June’s Prime Day event, with it keeping above $290 until the October Prime Day saw it first fall to $280 on the first day and then $267 on the second day. Now, while it may not be the lowest price we have tracked, you’re still getting $153 savings that lands it $20 under that Prime pricing. You can check out all the brand’s other current tool deals in the official Amazon storefront here .
